meta.name: peec-cluster
meta.description: Turns a Peec AI prompt set into strategic content zones — not keyword groups. Groups prompts by buyer intent + funnel stage + visibility gap + shared demand signals, producing 4–8 "content zones" with the competitive weakness to attack, supporting evidence (forum quotes, SERP patterns), and a rank-ordered next-move per zone. Use when a Peec project has 20+ prompts and needs a topic architecture — not a flat content calendar. Output is a strategic map, not a list.
